title: 傷
teacherNotes: Production C complete-package handoff for L285 傷. Use the approved sentences exactly. Latest origin/main is formally through L274 卡, so L280 積, L281 堆, L282 洞, L283 破, and L284 口 are provisional dependencies. Do not merge production JSON until L280-L284 exist in latest origin/main. Use Taiwan Traditional Chinese and Taiwan zhuyin only. spokenText must equal text with punctuation removed. No Han characters outside allowedChars may appear in text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, or Stage 4 option text. Generate standalone AI character audio for 傷 as char-u50b7.m4a; do not cut it from sentence audio. generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Use latest origin/main L001-L274 learned characters plus provisionalLearnedChars 積 堆 洞 破 口 plus current new char 傷.
usageNotes: Do not add unapproved display characters in text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, or Stage 4 option text.

No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, or readable marks.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩手上有一個很小的傷口，主角媽媽正在溫和查看或安撫她。畫面重點是小傷口和被照顧的安心感；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角媽媽溫和安撫主角小女孩，主角小女孩手上只有小小傷口，表情慢慢放心。畫面要清楚是「傷口不大，不要緊」；不可血腥，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩在水盆或淺水邊拿著一艘破掉的小玩具船，沒有把船放進水裡。畫面要清楚呈現小船破了所以不能下水玩；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角小女孩在沙地或遊樂場隧道口前，看見洞口堆積很多沙子，洞口被沙子擋住一部分。畫面要清楚呈現洞口、堆積、很多沙子；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 新衣服破了個洞，我很傷心。
